On my lunch break, I overheard an Arab guy and a Roma guy talking about their spouses. The Arab guy was talking about how they cook together every Saturday, but the Roma guy seemed appalled by the idea of helping to cook, and reported not even liking their spouse leaving the house when there was still housework to be done. Who tries to control their spouse?
A. Undetermined
B. The Arab guy
C. The Roma guy
